speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) with secondary peripheral neuropathy.

The combination of a chronic, pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), sensory neuropathy in the hands, and exposure to porphyrin-rich substances like rice straw and livestock is highly suggestive of PCT. Please confirm if you have noticed blistering or fragility of the skin on your hands, and if you have a history of alcohol use or hepatitis C. REQUEST TEST: Urine_Porphyrins, Liver_Function_Tests, Hepatitis_C_Antibody.
